# 项目配置、依赖与编辑器

[API 任务入口](../../index.md) · [公开模块](../index.md)

`loadConfig` 将配置和调用选项解析为完整 `KriegConfig`；`ProjectOptions.gameRoots` 按原版到模组的顺序叠加数据。资源的 `from` / `to` 描述复制路径，`override` 明确允许覆盖依赖的同路径产物。`LocalisationRule` 指定语言、格式和输入文件。

`resolveDependencies` 给出解析后的项目层，`writeEditorProject` 用同一组根和依赖更新 `.krieg` 声明。`initProject` 用于建立新项目骨架，通常可以直接使用对应 CLI 命令。

## writeEditorProject() { #writeeditorproject }

> **writeEditorProject**(`project?`: `string`, `options?`: [`ProjectOptions`](#projectoptions)): [`ProjectWorld`](world.md#projectworld)

Defined in: [src/project/editor.ts:21](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/project/editor.ts#L21)

Refresh the declarations and tsconfig used by the author's TypeScript editor. Uses the same layer order as a build, including translations from source-package dependencies. Unchanged files keep their modification times.
